messages:
tess-people-ops: Heads up 1: employee on unpaid medical leave (returned this week) is asking if we can process missed catch-up contributions and confirm whether their employer match vests while they were unpaid. Migration to new 401k vendor is this weekend, worried about timing. @jon-payroll @maya-benefits

jon-payroll: Short answer: missed employee elective deferrals must be entered by payroll to be forwarded. Catch-ups (50+) are allowed retroactively but need an employee-signed Catch-Up Authorization + payroll confirmation. If the payroll cutover happens before we submit the correction, it will be a manual vendor adjustment after migration.

maya-benefits: On vesting: vesting schedules are based on service and plan terms. Unpaid leave can be treated differently depending on FMLA/service-credit policy. For medical leave we generally grant service credit while the leave is covered by FMLA, but not for extended unpaid time without approval. We need HR case notes to determine if the period counts toward vesting.

alex-people-ops: Practical ask: what should managers tell returning employees who expect the employer match to show up immediately?

jon-payroll: Tell them: employer match posts after employer contributions are processed; if match for missed deferrals requires a retro adjustment, it may take 2-4 weeks post-migration. If payroll has the periods and amounts, run RD401K_CATCHUP_LEAVE ticket with supporting docs. Example ticket body below.

```
Employee: Carlos Mendez (ID 77421)
Action: Process retro catch-up contributions for pay periods 2026-08-01 -> 2026-10-15 (employee age 51)
Amounts: $1,200 catch-up total; regular deferrals $2,500
Payroll codes: RD401K_RETRO, RD401K_CATCHUP_LEAVE
Attachments: signed Catch-Up Authorization, payroll confirmation screenshots, HR leave approval
Submitter: Alex HR Ops
```

maya-benefits: We'll need the signed form that explicitly states the employee elects catch-up for those periods and acknowledgement of tax consequences. For vesting questions, submit HR case ID and the original leave approval. If service credit applies, we can request a vesting correction from the vendor (code: VEST_ADJ). Vendor may charge a small admin fee.

finance-ops: Finance note: retro catch-ups and match adjustments will increase liabilities and possibly require W-2 corrections. Please cc finance on any RD401K_RETRO or VEST_ADJ tickets so we can reserve the right accrual and forecast cashflow.

tess-people-ops: Thanks 1. I'll draft a short script for managers: what to tell employees, what forms are needed, and an off-cycle ticket template. We'll push to handbook and hiring channels.

migration-bot: Reminder: Provider migration blackout: 2026-09-03 23:00 PT -> 2026-09-05 06:00 PT. Only emergency payroll tickets accepted. Manual corrections submitted during blackout will be processed after cutover. See migration playbook: https://benefits.example.com/migration-playbook

jon-payroll: Last operational detail: if the employee return date is before payroll file generation, we can include normal deferrals in the upcoming cycle; if after, we need RD401K_OFFC for immediate inclusion. Use RD401K_RETRO only for prior periods.

tess-people-ops: Perfect. I'll add both ticket templates (off-cycle vs retro) and the manager script. Anything else? :white_check_mark:
